scope: Bounded upstream conversion-lineage review and new Bridge matrix derivation

tfds_rtx.finding: Routes to preconverted GCS data; Bridge points to bridge_data_v2/0.0.1; BC-Z points to bc_z/0.1.0.

tfds_importer.finding: Reads an existing GCS TFDS builder and converts features to numpy; strips some identity keys; is not the raw acquisition converter.

bridge_numpy_rlds.finding: Same numpy_256/scripted_numpy_256 lineage and file_path/episode_id pattern as cached metadata; copies state/action arrays. No time_stamp output. Version declared 1.0.0, while cache is 0.0.1; export commit not recovered.

bridge_raw_numpy.finding: Copies full_state and raw time_stamp into numpy observations; shifts pre-2021-07-23 observations against actions for camera latency. This correction is not automatically reapplied to an already converted cache.

bridge_robot_state.finding: Transforms controller Cartesian pose through transform2state; full_state and ROS time_stamp are separate fields.

bridge_robot_rotation.finding: Recorded Euler angles describe R_tool @ D.T; reconstruction is R_euler @ D. Euler matrix order is Rz @ Ry @ Rx. D is not generally identity.

bridge_default_rotation.finding: D is a fixed nonidentity tool rotation composed with configured normal_base_angle; historical episode configuration is not included in the cache.

bridge_alternate_raw_rlds.finding: A different raw-data export: version 1.0.0, 480x640 images plus depth and raw trajectory paths; cannot substitute it for the cached 256x256 numpy export.

language_table_author.finding: Real dataset identified by 442226 episodes; README example points to 0.0.1, cache is 0.1.0. Public simulation configuration uses 10Hz; does not establish real exported observation spacing.

bcz_author.location: Inference conversion of predicted axis_angle residual to target pose
bcz_author.finding: Adds axis-angle residual to the current axis-angle representation; this model source is not the local TFDS 1.0.0 raw export converter.

octo_transforms.finding: RT-1 reached quaternion is passed through as proprio, not independently converted or documented. Bridge transform explicitly distinguishes its newer copy from official OXE. Downstream training code is not independent proof of cached quaternion order.

Bridge.converter_family_support: Matching original paths, metadata construction and direct array copies; exact version/commit remains unbound
Bridge.orientation_support: Public collector records default-adjusted XYZ Euler angles; recorded axes are not automatically physical TCP axes
Bridge.time_recovery_route: Matching original numpy observation time_stamp or raw obs_dict.pkl; field omitted by the inspected numpy-to-RLDS converter
Bridge.metadata_flags_caution: Inspected numpy converter tests image keys against the observation list rather than its dictionary; consistent with previously observed false flags. No new payloads read and no global correction inferred.

Language Table.orientation_support: No orientation field; retain planar XY mask and unknown gripper input
Language Table.missing_evidence: Real exporter version binding, XY unit/frame and real observation timing; simulation constants are insufficient

BC-Z.missing_evidence: Cached google3 TFDS 1.0.0 export code or release specification for xyz units, rotation vector and observation timing

Fractal.missing_evidence: Cached exporter specification for meters and xyzw/wxyz orientation order plus observation timestamp/downsampling semantics

bridge_default_rotation_derivation.public_code_relationship: R_recorded = R_tool @ D.T; R_tool = R_recorded @ D
bridge_default_rotation_derivation.new_source_cartesian_rotation: R_future @ R_current.T; constant right D cancels

bounded_next_evidence: Use matching raw/numpy timestamps and release metadata if already available; otherwise obtain dataset-maintainer documentation for the exact cached schema.
Verify position units and Fractal quaternion ordering independently before freezing normalization or executable full-pose labels.
Decide and document a target-time protocol only after export timing is supported; do not silently treat nominal control frequency as measured timestamps.
Then enumerate eligible windows within the frozen episode roles; do not repartition or launch another fit to compensate for missing provenance.
